req_desc: The product is a console for an organisation that buys metered speech recognition ...
An owner reads the organisation, every project, all usage, invoices, the balance ledger, the audit record ...
A correct email with a correct password returns a bearer token ...
The organisation switcher lists only organisations the principal belongs to ...
Creating a project opens a modal on the project index ...
A credential carries exactly one project, fixed at creation ...
Submitting a clip for recognition returns the transcript of the clip ...
The usage intake verifies a presented credential by prefix followed by hash comparison ...
A usage screen takes a date range ...
A balance is an append-only ledger rather than a mutable number ...
The roles are `owner`, `administrator`, `member`, `auditor` ...
A terms page is reachable from the footer of every page ...
The sign-in route is `/sign-in` ...
The page ground is a near-black neutral that almost nothing brightens ...
The sign-in page is served as complete HTML carrying its own links ...
All timestamps are stored in coordinated universal time ...
Surfaces step upward from the ground in four further near-black neutrals ...
A marketing pricing address answers not found ...
The app is reachable at `APP_PUBLIC_URL` ...
